segments.en: Interest rates have moved away from the effective lower bound, driven in part by structural pressures that includes, in particular, in this part of the world, rising defence spending.
segments.zh: 利率已脱离有效下限，部分原因是结构性压力，特别是在欧洲，国防开支上升。

segments.en: And the shocks of this era are more likely to fall on the supply side than on the demand side.
segments.zh: 这个时代的冲击更可能来自供给侧而非需求侧。

segments.en: Because these negative supply shocks have tended to push prices upwards, interest rates have moved away from the effective lower bound.
segments.zh: 由于负面供给冲击推高价格，利率已脱离有效下限。
